svg.title: Step 3: RS485 sensors in the cold room
svg.text: Step 3: RS485 sensors in the cold room
One CAT5 cable chains all sensors. The ESP32 stays outside the room.
VIN and GND on the bottom row stay wired as in step 2.
Every XY-MD03 ships as address 1. Wire one
sensor alone, set its address in the web UI,
put a label on it, then add the next one.
